pages.text: This is an improved version of $(l:utility/diamond_auto_pruner)Diamond Auto Pruner$(). It has the same capabilities.$(br2)In one case, however, it has an individual function - when a craftable $(l:additional/end_portal_frame)End Portal Frame$() is placed and tool has '$(6)Silk Touch$()' and '$(6)Channeling$()' enchants you can$(br)
$(br)break frame.$(br2)This action will disable the portal.$(br)
